instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

questions.text: Which of the following is the meaning of 'conceal'?
Give the meaning of the following foreign phrases : (i) RSVP (ii) Faux pas
Use the following phrases to form sentences : (i) Keep an eye on (ii) Once in a while
Which of the following is odd man out of the group?
Which of the following is the prefix of 'new'?
Make antonyms of the following by adding suitable prefixes : (i) Able (ii) Agree

Fill in the blanks with the correct form of verbs given in brackets : (i) It was warm, so I ______ (take) off my coat. (ii) She wasn't hungry, so she ______ (eat) nothing. (iii) The window was open and a bird ______ (fly) into the room. (iv) She was very tired, so she ______ (go) to bed early.

Give one-word substitute for the following : (a) A person who believes in fate (b) A book published after the death of its author (c) A game in which no one wins (d) A government by one (e) A grass-eating animal (f) A man who gets irritated easily (g) A person who speaks two languages
Write an essay on the importance of social networking sites in our lives. Follow Paragraph Writing rules to complete the essay.

Make sentences to bring out the difference between the following pairs of words : (a) accept, except (b) affect, effect (c) aloud, allowed (d) cereal, serial (e) bare, bear (f) dessert, desert (g) sight, site
Write a letter to a travel agency to book a seat for you by flight no. C748 from New Delhi to Mumbai on 17th December, 2013.
Transcribe the following words phonemically and mark the primary stress : (a) Subject (b) Record (c) Duplicate (d) Payee (e) Biology (f) Examination (g) Admit
Give a technical description of the following devices in 200 words : (a) Telephone (b) Lathe machine

Pick out the error in each part of the following sentences and correct them : Writing letters is a necessity to fulfil (a) ______ social obligations and meet personal needs. (b) ______ These may not be directly related for your (c) ______ professional work. Promptness and choice of (d) ______ an appropriate format and style are the (e) ______ essentials of successful social correspondence. (f) ______ social correspondence usually has an air of easy (g) ______ and casualness about it.
Imagine you are the Secretary of your institute's Red Cross Society. Draft a notice informing everyone about a Blood Donation Camp that is being organized in the campus.
